description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying project details within a dashboard application. It includes server-side functions for fetching project data, ensures user authentication, and renders project information along with associated tasks. It leverages React components, Next.js-specific functions, and custom libraries for API requests and authentication.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Server-side function to retrieve project details by ID from the /projects endpoint, returning null if not found or on failure.

methods.name: ProjectDetailPage
methods.description: Main React component for the project detail page. Ensures user authentication, fetches project and task data, handles not found scenarios, and renders the page layout with project info and task list.
